app_summary: The application implements a hotel reservation service, built with Go and gRPC. The initial project is extended in several ways, including adding back-end in-memory and persistent databases, adding a recommender system for obtaining hotel recommendations, and adding the functionality to place a hotel reservation.
RCA_gt: The `geo` deployment is deliberately changed from the normal Hotel Reservation image to the known-buggy `yinfangchen/geo:app3` image. That image connects to MongoDB at `mongodb-geo:27777`, while `mongodb-geo` listens on the default port 27017, so the geo process cannot reach its database ("no reachable servers"), panics during database initialization and enters CrashLoopBackOff. Identifying this wrong MongoDB port in the geo application configuration is the correct mechanism; naming the image replacement as its origin is a plus but not required.
_source_comment: Ground truth source: AIOpsLab/aiopslab/orchestrator/problems/misconfig_app/misconfig_app_hotel_res.py (faulty_service); AIOpsLab/aiopslab/generators/fault/inject_app.py (image changed to yinfangchen/geo:app3); AIOpsLab/aiopslab/orchestrator/problems/registry.py (problem ID). DB URL mongodb-geo:27777 confirmed by the geo container log line "Read database URL: mongodb-geo:27777" in the Hotel Reservation runs.
